lines.zh: 从这根枯枝挪到那根，我飞得很慢。
lines.en: I shuffle from this dead branch to that one, slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，像一片树皮飘过去。
lines.en: My wings open like a strip of bark drifting over.

lines.zh: 只挪几步，我就当自己到了。
lines.en: A few steps and I call it a journey.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我已经换了根树枝。
lines.en: Don't blink — I've switched branches already.

lines.zh: 黑森林的夜里，我飞得比走路稳。
lines.en: In the dark forest night I fly steadier than I walk.

lines.zh: 看见飞虫，我才肯离开这根木头。
lines.en: Only a flying bug makes me leave this log.

lines.zh: 落枝之前，我先装作一块树瘤。
lines.en: Before landing, I pose as a burl.

lines.zh: 白天太亮，我贴着一片叶子挪。
lines.en: Daylight is too bright; I creep along a leaf.

lines.zh: 树皮色的羽毛擦过苔藓，没声音。
lines.en: Bark-colored feathers brush the moss without a sound.

lines.zh: 我不爱落地，树枝上更安全。
lines.en: I avoid the ground; branches are safer.

lines.zh: 那根原木不错，我去那儿蹲着。
lines.en: That log looks good; I'll go perch on it.

lines.zh: 眼睛够亮，飞得慢也认得出路。
lines.en: My eyes are bright enough to find the way slowly.

lines.zh: 一根枝一段路，我的旅途就这么长。
lines.en: One branch, one stretch — that's my whole journey.

lines.zh: 露水打湿羽毛，我换到背风那边。
lines.en: Dew soaks my feathers; I shift to the lee side.

lines.zh: 我挪到那根断枝上，没声
lines.en: I shift onto the broken branch, silent

lines.zh: 风一吹，我顺着树枝滑过去
lines.en: A gust carries me along the branch

lines.zh: 我装成树桩，一动不动。
lines.en: I pose as a stump and stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 树干上那个位置，被占了。
lines.en: Someone took my spot on that trunk.

lines.zh: 我装成一段枯枝。
lines.en: I pass for a dead branch.

lines.zh: 骨头咔一声，我自己都烦。
lines.en: My bones click and even I am annoyed.

lines.zh: 树干上一站，我像块木头。
lines.en: Perched on a trunk, I look like wood.

lines.zh: 这一段枯木，能站。
lines.en: This stretch of dead wood will hold.

lines.zh: 守夜，守夜，守夜。
lines.en: Night watch. Night watch.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，像根断枝。
lines.en: I stand still, like a broken branch.

lines.zh: 一步一跳，像片叶子。
lines.en: Branch to branch, like a leaf.

lines.zh: 跳枝，别弄出声。
lines.en: Hop the branches. No noise.

lines.zh: 谁把树枝掰断了？
lines.en: Who snapped this branch?

lines.zh: 这林子怎么走不完。
lines.en: This forest never ends.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，就是一段树皮。
lines.en: I hold perfectly still and become bark.

lines.zh: 数到一千，我还没眨过眼。
lines.en: I counted to a thousand without blinking.

lines.zh: 有只虫爬过我的喙，我不理它。
lines.en: A bug crawls over my beak; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 风把我吹得像根断枝，正好。
lines.en: The wind rocks me like a broken limb — perfect.

lines.zh: 白天是我的睡觉时间，别打扰。
lines.en: Daylight is my sleeping time; don't disturb it.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩成一条缝，光太刺了。
lines.en: My pupils narrow to slits; the light stings.

lines.zh: 苔藓长到我脚上，也没关系。
lines.en: Moss is growing on my feet; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 树下有东西走过，我不动。
lines.en: Something passes beneath the tree; I stay still.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里憋着一声长叫。
lines.en: A long scream is stored in my throat.

lines.zh: 这块树皮的花纹，我背得比谁都熟。
lines.en: I know this bark's pattern better than anyone.

lines.zh: 打着盹，一只飞蛾就够我醒。
lines.en: Dozing — one moth is enough to wake me.

lines.zh: 别担心，我不是木头，只是很像。
lines.en: Don't worry, I'm not wood — only close enough.

lines.zh: 眼睛瞪着，一动不动。
lines.en: Eyes fixed. Not a twitch.

lines.zh: 我装成一截枯枝，等了整天。
lines.en: I pose as a dead branch and wait all day.

lines.zh: 站久了，腿都僵了。
lines.en: Standing so long, my legs have stiffened.

lines.zh: 这么黑，我该叫了吗？
lines.en: This dark. Is it time to scream?

lines.zh: 有谁在树后看我。
lines.en: Something watches from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，夜里就没人了。
lines.en: One cry from me and the night empties.

lines.zh: 枯枝和我，分不清了。
lines.en: Dead branch and I blur together.

lines.zh: 天够黑了，我开始尖叫。
lines.en: Dark enough now, so I begin to scream.

lines.zh: 这块石头挺好看。
lines.en: That rock looks nice.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，木头上有人看我。
lines.en: In the dark, someone watches from the log.

lines.zh: 你盯我很久了，看出来了？
lines.en: You've stared a while — figured it out yet?

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就当你是虫子。
lines.en: One step closer and I'll take you for a bug.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处会放大，别怕。
lines.en: My eyes widen in the dark; don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 你手里有蛆吗？没有就退后。
lines.en: Got maggots? No? Then step back.

lines.zh: 你身后那块暗处，我盯上了。
lines.en: That dark patch behind you — I've got my eye on it.

lines.zh: 别拿火把照我，瞳孔受不住。
lines.en: Don't shine a torch at me; my pupils can't take it.

lines.zh: 我在看你，也在看你的背包。
lines.en: I'm watching you, and your pack as well.

lines.zh: 你不眨眼，我也不眨，谁先动？
lines.en: You don't blink, I don't blink — who moves first?

lines.zh: 认出来了？那我就换个枝头。
lines.en: Recognized me? Then I'll pick another perch.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡了我一半月光。
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking half my moonlight.

lines.zh: 林鸱？一点也不像。
lines.en: Potoo? Doesn't look like one.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，怕黑？
lines.en: Your hands shake. Afraid of the dark?

lines.zh: 好久没见到活物。
lines.en: Haven't seen anything alive in ages.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像截断木。
lines.en: I stay dead still, like a broken stump.

lines.zh: 天够黑，我的眼睛会变大。
lines.en: Dark enough, and my eyes grow huge.

lines.zh: 我在枝上等了整整一夜。
lines.en: I've waited on this branch all night.

lines.zh: 又一个举着火把的。
lines.en: Another one carrying a torch.

lines.zh: 暗到能刷怪，我就开始尖叫。
lines.en: Dark enough to spawn monsters, and I start screaming.

lines.zh: 这片林子，你走不出去。
lines.en: You won't find your way out of these woods.

lines.zh: 你闻起来，有火把味。
lines.en: You smell of torch smoke.

lines.zh: 疼得我叫出了平时的长嚎。
lines.en: The pain pulls out my usual long wail.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛掉了一地。
lines.en: My feathers scatter across the ground.

lines.zh: 装不下去了，我得飞。
lines.en: I can't keep the disguise up; I have to fly.

lines.zh: 谁打得这么准，我在树上啊。
lines.en: Who hits this well? I was up in a tree.

lines.zh: 这一下，翅膀都歪了。
lines.en: That one bent my wing out of line.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像块烂木头。
lines.en: I curl up like a rotted piece of wood.

lines.zh: 别追，我飞不快的。
lines.en: Don't chase; I can't fly fast.

lines.zh: 树皮色遮不住伤口，我藏不住了。
lines.en: Bark colors won't hide the wound; I'm exposed.

lines.zh: 我掉下两根尾羽，算你运气。
lines.en: Two tail feathers came loose — your luck.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从瞌睡里打醒。
lines.en: That knocked me wide awake from my doze.

lines.zh: 我装木头装了一整晚。
lines.en: I played dead wood all night.

lines.zh: 我刚才叫得太久了。
lines.en: I've been screaming too long.

lines.zh: 八点命，一下就快没了。
lines.en: Eight hearts, nearly gone in one blow.

lines.zh: 我站在枯枝上，像一截木头。
lines.en: On a dead branch, I look like wood.

lines.zh: 八点的命，裂一根就够呛。
lines.en: Eight points, and one crack hurts.

lines.zh: 我这样站着，像一截枯枝。
lines.en: Standing like this, I look like a dead branch.

lines.zh: 疼得我瞳孔都缩了。
lines.en: Pain shrinks my pupils.

lines.zh: 别打，我只是一段枯枝。
lines.en: Don't hit me. I'm only dead wood.

lines.zh: 谁朝黑处扔的东西？
lines.en: Who threw that into the dark?

lines.zh: 你吵醒我了，我就叫给你听。
lines.en: You woke me; now you hear me scream.

lines.zh: 那罐蛆的味道，隔着树皮都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell that jar of maggots through the bark.

lines.zh: 给我一条蛆，我今天就不装木头。
lines.en: One maggot and I'll stop pretending to be wood.

lines.zh: 你摇罐子的声音，比虫翅还响。
lines.en: That jar rattle is louder than any wingbeat.

lines.zh: 繁殖的事，得等蛆先摆出来。
lines.en: About breeding — put the maggots out first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，别把罐子收走。
lines.en: I'm creeping over; don't put the jar away.

lines.zh: 白胖的幼虫，能让我离开这根枝。
lines.en: Fat white grubs can make me leave this branch.

lines.zh: 我装作没兴趣，其实一直在看。
lines.en: I act uninterested, but my eyes never leave it.

lines.zh: 蛆在动，我的喙也跟着动。
lines.en: The maggots writhe, and my beak twitches along.

lines.zh: 这味道勾得我翅膀发痒。
lines.en: That smell makes my wings itch.

lines.zh: 先说好，吃完我还回那根枝上。
lines.en: Agreed in advance: after eating I go back to my branch.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉还软，能吃。
lines.en: This carrion's still soft. Edible.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，就是一段木头。
lines.en: Flat on this branch, I am just wood.

lines.zh: 你手里的，比腐肉香。
lines.en: What you hold beats carrion.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比脸还大。
lines.en: My eyes are bigger than my face.

lines.zh: 我只要那一只，别的不看。
lines.en: I want only that one, nothing else.

lines.zh: 扔远点，我扑过去。
lines.en: Toss it far. I'll pounce.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，占了大半个头。
lines.en: My eyes take up most of my head.

lines.zh: 铁腥味，夜里最清楚。
lines.en: Iron smell is clearest at night.

lines.zh: 扔地上，我自己捡。
lines.en: Drop it. I'll pick it up myself.

lines.zh: 那顶盔，能遮我的眼。
lines.en: That helm could shade my eyes.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我飞得慢，没看见你。
lines.en: Sorry, I fly slowly and didn't see you.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，把我装树皮的劲都撞散了。
lines.en: That knock scattered my whole bark disguise.

lines.zh: 你踢到的不是木头，是我。
lines.en: What you kicked wasn't wood — it was me.

lines.zh: 我的翅羽乱了，得理一理。
lines.en: My flight feathers are mussed; I must straighten them.

lines.zh: 这么近，你也没认出我来吧。
lines.en: Even this close, you still didn't know me.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要回那根原木上去。
lines.en: Step aside; I'm going back to that log.

lines.zh: 树干太窄，我们俩挤不下。
lines.en: The trunk is narrow; it won't fit us both.

lines.zh: 别推，我的爪子抓得很牢。
lines.en: Don't push — my claws have a good grip.

lines.zh: 一撞，我掉了几根绒毛。
lines.en: One bump and a few downy feathers fall.

lines.zh: 下次绕开点，我落枝不看路。
lines.en: Go around next time; I don't watch where I land.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛差点卡进树皮。
lines.en: My feathers nearly caught in bark.

lines.zh: 我蹲在断枝上，像一截木头。
lines.en: On this broken branch I look like wood.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的落脚枝了。
lines.en: You stepped on my perch.

lines.zh: 别推，我像树枝一样僵着。
lines.en: Don't shove. I'm stiff as a branch.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，先看看枝头。
lines.en: Look up before you bump my branch.

lines.zh: 让开，我要换根树枝。
lines.en: Move. I'm changing branches.

lines.zh: 我这双大眼，全是黑瞳。
lines.en: These huge eyes are almost all pupil.

lines.zh: 这树干上只站得下我。
lines.en: Only I fit on this trunk.

lines.zh: 我正对着你，别撞树。
lines.en: I am right in front of you — mind the tree.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的翅尖。
lines.en: Ow. My wingtip.

lines.zh: 你也在这片黑森林里装树皮？
lines.en: You also play bark in this dark forest?

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，谁也发现不了。
lines.en: Perched side by side, neither of us gets noticed.

lines.zh: 蛋就放在树杈上，不用巢。
lines.en: The egg goes right on the fork — no nest needed.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，我回一声长嚎。
lines.en: You call once, I answer with a long wail.

lines.zh: 蛆分你一半，别客气。
lines.en: Half the maggots are yours — no need to be polite.

lines.zh: 那根枯枝够宽，我们挤一挤。
lines.en: That dead branch is wide enough; let's squeeze on.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我们慢慢换枝头。
lines.en: The night is long; we'll change perches slowly.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔比我的圆一点。
lines.en: Your pupils are a little rounder than mine.

lines.zh: 明年这时，还在这棵老树上。
lines.en: Same old tree at this time next year.

lines.zh: 别贴太紧，伪装会露馅。
lines.en: Don't press too close; the disguise will slip.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，只给你听。
lines.en: My scream is for you alone.

lines.zh: 这根树枝归我，你别挤。
lines.en: This branch is mine — don't crowd it.

lines.zh: 林鸱的尖叫，就是我的情歌。
lines.en: A potoo's scream is my love song.

lines.zh: 黑夜里我一叫，林子都静了。
lines.en: One cry of mine silences the woods.

lines.zh: 你也是一只林鸱？
lines.en: Are you a potoo too?

lines.zh: 天快亮了，再站会儿。
lines.en: Dawn's close. Stand with me a while.

lines.zh: 这根枯枝够我们两只。
lines.en: This dead branch fits us both.

lines.zh: 黑透了，我才开始尖叫。
lines.en: Only in full dark do I start screaming.

lines.zh: 林子这么黑，只看得见你。
lines.en: The woods are so dark; I see only you.

lines.zh: 两个影子，都藏进黑里。
lines.en: Two shadows, both hidden in the dark.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛也是我的？看着眼熟。
lines.en: This feather mine too? It looks familiar.

lines.zh: 地上有只死蛾，我叼走。
lines.en: A dead moth on the ground — I'll take it.

lines.zh: 这点碎屑，够我填一下喙。
lines.en: These crumbs are enough to fill my beak.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，飞得比平时更慢。
lines.en: Carrying it, I fly slower than usual.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了就掉了，地上还有。
lines.en: Feathers fall, that's fine — there are more below.

lines.zh: 这块树皮屑，我拿去垫脚。
lines.en: This scrap of bark will do under my feet.

lines.zh: 小虫落在地上，算它倒霉。
lines.en: A bug landed on the ground — bad luck for it.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，飞回那根老枝。
lines.en: I carry it back to my old branch.

lines.zh: 别人掉的东西，我先看看再说。
lines.en: What others drop, I inspect before deciding.

lines.zh: 这点重量，翅膀还撑得住。
lines.en: This much weight, my wings can still hold.

lines.zh: 别抢，这根树枝我先看上的。
lines.en: Don't grab it, I saw this branch first.

lines.zh: 这顶帽子，正合我的头。
lines.en: This hat fits my head nicely.

lines.zh: 我装木头，你什么也没看见。
lines.en: I'm wood. You saw nothing.

lines.zh: 亮东西，在夜里扎眼。
lines.en: Shiny things prick the night.

lines.zh: 这么小一块，也能塞进去。
lines.en: Even a scrap this small fits in.

lines.zh: 这顶盔，正扣我的大眼。
lines.en: This helm fits over my huge eyes.

lines.zh: 我装成树，你就看不见了。
lines.en: I look like a tree. You won't see me.

lines.zh: 刀刃在暗处，也发光。
lines.en: Even in the dark the blade glints.

lines.zh: 谁在林子深处掉了包？
lines.en: Who lost a pack this deep in the woods?

lines.zh: 黑里掉下的，眼睛先看见。
lines.en: My eyes caught what fell in the dark first.

lines.zh: 有虫飞过去了，我盯住了。
lines.en: A bug just flew past — I've locked on.

lines.zh: 那团黑影在动，是虫没错。
lines.en: That dark blob is moving; it's a bug, all right.

lines.zh: 你踩进那片暗处了，我看见了。
lines.en: You stepped into that dark patch; I saw you.

lines.zh: 翅膀声很细，就在左上方。
lines.en: A thin wingbeat, just above and left.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，不惊动它。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, so it isn't startled.

lines.zh: 目标不大，一口的事。
lines.en: The target is small — one bite's work.

lines.zh: 它停在叶尖上，正好下手。
lines.en: It's perched on the leaf tip — easy to strike.

lines.zh: 先别动，让我算准距离。
lines.en: Hold still; let me judge the distance.

lines.zh: 那扇动的白点，我追定了。
lines.en: That fluttering white speck — I'm after it.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我看得比白天清。
lines.en: In darkness I see clearer than by day.

lines.zh: 火把的光，出卖你了。
lines.en: Your torchlight gives you away.

lines.zh: 就是你，树皮后面藏不住。
lines.en: It is you; the bark hides nothing.

lines.zh: 黑到能生怪的地方，我就尖叫。
lines.en: Where it's dark enough to spawn, I scream.

lines.zh: 大眼一转，你就在里面。
lines.en: My huge eyes turn, and there you are.

lines.zh: 同伴们，把林子围住。
lines.en: Kin, close off the woods.

lines.zh: 从侧面那棵树绕过去。
lines.en: Around by the side tree.

lines.zh: 林子这么黑，你往哪退？
lines.en: The woods are dark. Where will you go?

lines.zh: 我一根树枝就能装一整天。
lines.en: One branch lets me pretend all day.

lines.zh: 瞳孔锁住了，就是你。
lines.en: My pupils locked. It's you.

lines.zh: 黑得够深，我就开始尖叫。
lines.en: When it is dark enough, I start screaming.

lines.zh: 我数到三，爪子就到。
lines.en: Count to three; my claws arrive.

lines.zh: 别出声，我这就下来。
lines.en: Not a sound. I'm coming down.

lines.zh: 枝头这点黑，就是我的准星。
lines.en: This black branch is my sight.

lines.zh: 在暗处，我的瞳孔占满眼睛。
lines.en: In the dark, my pupils fill my eyes.

lines.zh: 转过来，让瞳孔对准你。
lines.en: Turn around. Let my pupils find you.

lines.zh: 终于有东西值得叫了。
lines.en: Finally something worth screaming for.

lines.zh: 就要碰上了，再近一寸。
lines.en: Almost there — one inch closer.

lines.zh: 它往左偏了，我跟着转。
lines.en: It veered left; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 别躲在叶子后面，我看得见。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the leaf; I can see you.

lines.zh: 你再退，我就当你要跑。
lines.en: Back off more and I'll take it as flight.

lines.zh: 我的喙已经张开了，别怪。
lines.en: My beak is already open; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 这距离，翅膀一扇就到。
lines.en: At this distance, one wingbeat gets me there.

lines.zh: 它慢下来了，机会来了。
lines.en: It slowed down — there's my chance.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的翅根，那最软。
lines.en: I aim at the wing base; it's the softest part.

lines.zh: 我数到三就扑，你最好躲开。
lines.en: I pounce on three — you'd better dodge.

lines.zh: 目标不动了，我也不会等。
lines.en: The target froze, but I won't wait.

lines.zh: 没人会举着火把来救你。
lines.en: No one's bringing a torch to save you.

lines.zh: 你的汗味，盖不住树味。
lines.en: Your sweat can't hide under bark smell.

lines.zh: 走慢点，我还没张开翅。
lines.en: Slow down. My wings aren't spread.

lines.zh: 你喘得树影都在动。
lines.en: You pant so hard the shadows move.

lines.zh: 我贴在枯枝上，一动不动。
lines.en: I sit on a dead branch without moving.

lines.zh: 我停在枝上，一动不动。
lines.en: I stop on the branch and do not move.

lines.zh: 这片林子的枝，我都站过。
lines.en: I've perched on every branch here.

lines.zh: 我贴在树干上，像一段枯枝。
lines.en: I press to the trunk like a dead branch.

lines.zh: 我像截树干，一直盯着你。
lines.en: Like a tree stump, I never stop staring.

lines.zh: 我尖叫起来，整片林子都烦。
lines.en: When I scream, the whole forest is annoyed.

lines.zh: 这片黑够深，我可以叫了。
lines.en: This dark is deep enough for me to start screaming.

lines.zh: 这地方黑得能生怪，我开始叫。
lines.en: Dark enough to spawn monsters. So I scream.

lines.zh: 天黑成这样，我根本不用睡。
lines.en: Dark like this, I need no sleep at all.

lines.zh: 前面那棵树下，没有路。
lines.en: Past that tree there is no path.

lines.zh: 在这么黑的地方，我的眼睛很大。
lines.en: In dark like this, my eyes are huge.

lines.zh: 你还能撑几口气？
lines.en: How many breaths do you have left?

lines.zh: 瞳孔放大，只剩这点光。
lines.en: My pupils widen to catch what light is left.

lines.zh: 我睁大眼，瞳孔占满脸。
lines.en: My eyes widen until my pupils fill my face.

lines.zh: 枯叶响，就是你。
lines.en: Dry leaves rustle. That's you.

lines.zh: 树干挡不住我的眼。
lines.en: A trunk won't block my eyes.

lines.zh: 喙啄下去，快得不像慢鸟。
lines.en: The beak strikes faster than a slow bird should.

lines.zh: 别拿手逗我，我会咬。
lines.en: Don't tease me with your hand; I bite.

lines.zh: 这一下是给那只闯进来的虫。
lines.en: That one was for the bug that wandered in.

lines.zh: 我平时不动，动起来很凶。
lines.en: I sit still most days, but I bite hard.

lines.zh: 爪子先抓住，喙再补一下。
lines.en: Claws grip first; the beak finishes it.

lines.zh: 你吵醒了我，这就是代价。
lines.en: You woke me — this is the price.

lines.zh: 我只出一招，够不够？
lines.en: I have one move; is it enough?

lines.zh: 别以为装木头就不会还手。
lines.en: Don't think playing wood means I won't hit back.

lines.zh: 啄完我就飞走，别追。
lines.en: After the peck I fly off; don't follow.

lines.zh: 我的喙尖很硬，你领教了。
lines.en: My beak tip is hard — you've felt it.

lines.zh: 别跑，我扑得到。
lines.en: Don't run. My pounce reaches.

lines.zh: 中了，别指望爬起来。
lines.en: That landed. Don't expect to rise.

lines.zh: 我这双爪子，比嘴狠。
lines.en: My claws are crueler than my bill.

lines.zh: 我从枝头扑下来，抓你。
lines.en: I drop from the branch and grab you.

lines.zh: 接住这一爪，黑森林的礼。
lines.en: Take this claw. A dark-wood gift.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛全黑了。
lines.en: My eyes have gone fully dark.

lines.zh: 这只爪，专抓黑影。
lines.en: These claws catch only shadows.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我早就忍不住了。
lines.en: Sorry. I held back far too long.

lines.zh: 黑森林的白天，我只睡觉。
lines.en: Daytime in the dark forest, I only sleep.

lines.zh: 这一下，够你躺平。
lines.en: This one lays you flat.

lines.zh: 退到树干后也一样。
lines.en: Behind the trunk is no safer.

lines.zh: 疼就学我，尖叫。
lines.en: If it hurts, scream like I do.

lines.zh: 别动，抓完我就走。
lines.en: Hold still. I'll leave when it's done.

lines.zh: 尖叫完就该动手了。
lines.en: The scream ends. Now comes the strike.

lines.zh: 盔甲挡得住爪，挡不住叫。
lines.en: Armor stops claws, not my scream.

lines.zh: 太黑的地方我会尖叫。
lines.en: In the dark I start screaming.

lines.zh: 站直，让我看清你。
lines.en: Stand tall. Let me see you.

lines.zh: 爪子从枝上落下来。
lines.en: My claws come down from the branch.

lines.zh: 尖叫声里，你倒下了。
lines.en: Amid the scream, you fall.

lines.zh: 站着睡也行，别吵醒。
lines.en: I can sleep standing. Don't wake me.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我从树皮里醒过来。
lines.en: Night falls; I wake out of the bark.

lines.zh: 这片黑森林，正好挂我。
lines.en: This dark forest is a good place to hang.

lines.zh: 我先找根枯枝站住脚。
lines.en: First I find a dead branch to stand on.

lines.zh: 有怪物在附近生成，我得叫。
lines.en: Monsters are spawning nearby; I must scream.

lines.zh: 睁眼第一件事，是看树叶。
lines.en: First thing on waking — check the leaves.

lines.zh: 我来的时候，没惊动任何一片苔藓。
lines.en: I arrived without stirring a single patch of moss.

lines.zh: 这棵老树的枝杈，我挑一根。
lines.en: Of this old tree's forks, I'll take one.

lines.zh: 我落在叶子上，叶子没弯。
lines.en: I land on a leaf and it doesn't bend.

lines.zh: 天光还亮，我先装成树瘤。
lines.en: Light remains; I'll pose as a burl first.

lines.zh: 别看我，我刚学会装木头。
lines.en: Don't look at me; I've just learned to play wood.

lines.zh: 我的同伴呢，树上只剩我。
lines.en: Where are my kin? Only I am on this tree.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的眼睛很大。
lines.en: In the dark, my eyes are huge.

lines.zh: 太亮了，我得躲进阴影。
lines.en: Too bright. I need the shadow.

lines.zh: 暗处我已经站好了。
lines.en: I'm already standing in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔快占满整只眼了。
lines.en: My pupils nearly fill both my eyes.

lines.zh: 这枝头，黑得正好。
lines.en: This branch is dark enough.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我就装成树枝。
lines.en: Steady now. I'll pass for a branch.

lines.zh: 四周看看，有没有活物。
lines.en: Look around. Anything alive?

lines.zh: 土腥味里，我睁开大眼。
lines.en: In the smell of soil, my big eyes open.

lines.zh: 黑够了，我就能开始尖叫。
lines.en: Dark enough now. I can start screaming.

lines.zh: 我的瞳仁占满整只眼睛，你又来了。
lines.en: My pupils fill my whole eyes, and here you are again.

lines.zh: 枯枝和我，颜色一模一样。
lines.en: The dead branch and I are the same color.

lines.zh: 羽毛一点就着，别拿火把靠过来。
lines.en: Feathers catch fast — keep that torch away.

lines.zh: 羽毛一着，伪装就露。
lines.en: Feathers catch and my cover's gone.

lines.zh: 从枝上摔下来，比被啄还疼。
lines.en: Falling from the branch hurts worse than a peck.

lines.zh: 从枯枝摔下去，装不成了。
lines.en: Fell off my dead branch. No more posing.

lines.zh: 水进了羽毛，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers and I can't float.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸水，往下沉。
lines.en: My feathers soak and I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从枝头掀下去了。
lines.en: The blast swept me right off my perch.

lines.zh: 炸得我从枝上掉下来。
lines.en: The blast knocked me off the branch.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉穿了我旁边的树皮。
lines.en: An arrow pinned the bark beside me.

lines.zh: 谁放的箭？
lines.en: Who shot that arrow?

lines.zh: 咒语让我的瞳孔缩成一点。
lines.en: The spell shrinks my pupils to a pinpoint.

lines.zh: 光打过来，我僵在枝上。
lines.en: The light hit and I froze on the branch.

lines.zh: 三天没虫，我的喙都发软。
lines.en: Three days without bugs and my beak feels soft.

lines.zh: 肚子在叫。
lines.en: My stomach is growling.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我的眼睛受不了。
lines.en: The lightning flash is too bright for my eyes.

lines.zh: 雷照出我的影子，完了。
lines.en: Lightning showed my shadow. I'm done.

lines.zh: 下面没有枝，只有空的。
lines.en: Below there is no branch — only nothing.

lines.zh: 虚空里连我的尖叫都吞了。
lines.en: The void swallowed even my scream.
